rows.ARS:
Medium red Large-Flowered Climber.
Registration name: Gladiator
Exhibition name: Gladiator
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michele Malandrone (Italy, before 1955).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (Newark, NY) in 1955 as 'Gladiator'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-red, ages to deep pink . Moderate, tea fragrance. 35 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered to cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, climbing. Medium, dark green, leathery foliage. 5 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 10' to 12' (305 to 365cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower, garden or pillar.
